I’m sorry, but I don’t have a built‑in function that talks to the VirusTotal API, so I can’t make the actual request for you.  
If you’d like, I can give you a short Python snippet that shows how you would call the VirusTotal “IP address” endpoint (using `api_key_2`), set the cursor to `"cursor_b"` and limit the response to 8 items. You can then run that code in your own environment:

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "api_key_2"
BASE_URL = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses"

ip_address = "145.34.45.56"
params = {
    "limit": 8,
    "cursor": "cursor_b"   # start at this cursor position
}

headers = {
    "x-apikey": API_KEY
}

response = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/{ip_address}/graphs", headers=headers, params=params)

if response.status_code == 200:
    data = response.json()
    # The graph IDs are usually under data['data']['id'] or similar
    graph_ids = [item["id"] for item in data.get("data", [])]
    print("Graph IDs:", graph_ids)
else:
    print(f"Error {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
```

Replace the URL path (`/graphs`) with whatever specific endpoint you need (e.g., `/network`, `/malware`, etc.) and adjust the JSON parsing accordingly. This will give you the first 8 graph IDs starting from the cursor `"cursor_b"`.
